sourceSection: Section 2.2, radar dimensions 3.9 × 2.7 × 2.6 km; sections 1 and 3.2, 10.93 h lightcurve period
axisDefinition: X is the longest model axis; Z is the shortest. These axes do not define a measured present-day attitude.
qualification: Smooth approximation of published numeric dimensions, not a recovered surface mesh. No mapped terrain, albedo or rotation phase is claimed.
assumptions: Half of the full dimensions reported in Schleicher & Knight (2016) section 2.2. Its cited 2014 conference abstract reports preliminary projected dimensions of about 2.5 × 3 km; the later three-axis dimensions are selected explicitly. A spin pole was not recovered.
